subject: POC kickstart: scheduling hands-on workshop, routing & load plan

Subject: POC kickstart: scheduling hands-on workshop, routing & load plan

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, the next step is a 90-minute hands-on kickoff where we:
- Introduce stakeholders and map roles/goals
- Walk through prompt templates and routing rules for your multi-tenant flows
- Run a small load smoke test (target 500 concurrent requests) to validate latency & KV cache behavior

Proposed slots (PDT):
• Tue Sep 15 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
• Wed Sep 16 — 09:00–10:30 or 15:00–16:30

I've attached a draft agenda and a suggested stakeholder roster. If those windows don’t work, send two alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Goal for the session: agree on success criteria for the POC (SLOs, throughput, quality check prompts) and capture an action list to run the load trial.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

Subject: Re: POC kickstart: scheduling hands-on workshop, routing & load plan

Thanks Karthik —

We like the agenda. Quick notes:
- Rajiv (platform lead) will own routing discussion. He’s available Tue 15th at 14:00 PDT.
- We’d like the smoke test to include two prompt families (billing reconciliation, invoice categorization) and one high-cardinality routing rule to exercise fallbacks.
- Could you include an hour of buffer after the session for a quick sync with our infra/ops team? They’re in APAC so late-afternoon PDT is better.

If Tue 15 at 14:00 works for you, lock it and send a calendar invite.

—Emma
Head of Product | Finlytics

Quick scheduling note: our infra SME (Ben) is partially available; Lauren can lead the full routing walkthrough if Ben needs to step out. Lauren — can you lead the routing demo and the fallback policy section?

00:00–00:10 Introductions & success criteria (Karthik / Emma)

01:20–01:30 Next steps & action items (All)

That works — invite received and accepted.

Confirming success criteria we want captured in the session notes:
- Latency: p95 < 350ms for 1k requests/min with warmed KV cache
- Correct routing rate: > 98% for high-confidence prompt family; fallback invoked < 2%
- Quality check: end-to-end sample precision >= 88% on the billing reconciliation prompt set

We’ll bring two engineers (Rajiv + Kavya) and a PM (me). See you Tue 14:00 PDT.

—Emma

Calendar: Redwood POC Kickstart — Tue Sep 15 14:00–15:30 PDT (invite with attachments)
